name: Eventide Spear can be activated from the material deck in the main phase while an opponent controls two rested units
notes: A Warrior champion clicks Eventide Spear in the material deck while the opponent controls two rested Dungeon Guards. The materialize phase only offers this clause to a player who takes part in the ordinary materialize (declining it skips the offer), so the card is also activatable by clicking it in the material deck during the main phase.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] As long as an opponent controls two or more rested units, you may activate this card from your material deck.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Eventide Spear could only be activated from the material deck through the materialize-phase offer, which a declined ordinary materialize skips; it had no main-phase activation.
